def getInt():
    import sys
    x = 0
    sign = 1
    c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while c and (c < '0' or c > '9'):
        if c == '-':
            sign = -1
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while c and '0' <= c <= '9':
        x = x * 10 + ord(c) - ord('0')
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    return x * sign

def mod_pow(base, exp, P):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % P
        base = base * base % P
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def comb(x, y, factorial, inv_factorial, P):
    if x < y or y < 0:
        return 0
    return factorial[x] * inv_factorial[y] % P * inv_factorial[x - y] % P

def sum_series(x):
    return x * (x + 1) // 2

n = getInt()
m = getInt()

maxn = n + 1
factorial = [1] * (maxn + 1)

for i in range(1, maxn + 1):

            + f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % P * (sum_series(j) + sum_series(i - 1 - j))) % P * comb(i - 1, j, factorial, inv_factorial, P)) % P
    f[i] = f[i] * (i + 1) % P

F = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
G = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]

F[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    F[i][i] = f[i]
    G[i][i] = g[i]
    for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):

print(G[m][n])
